notes.title: Our new pixel-art game is releasing today : Ganryu 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012250/2cedc0f1152ccea1cb5f005f0fddd139a7790b27.gif[/img]
Hello space troopers!

We're releasing another retro pixel-art game.. Ganryu 2 !
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856910/Ganryu_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856910/Ganryu_2/[/url]

Play as Miyamoto Musashi in this beautiful 2D platformer and travel through a 17th century fantasy Japan, from north to the island of Ganryu-jima where everything happened between Musashi and Kojiro. The game is inspired by the story of Takezo Musashi from the famous novel “The Stone And The Sword”.

All info : [url=https://www.ganryu2.com/]https://www.ganryu2.com/
[/url]


We do hope you'll like it as much as you liked Andro Dunos II!

notes.title: Minor bug fixes + New Exit Menu !
notes.notes:
Hello space troopers!

We had our first minor bug fixes.

[h1]New Exit Menu[/h1]
Our previous exit menu was a big rough, so we integrated a proper one in the main menu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012250/bd0f6178579e9c8ef2d2839d3d68fa46a494e228.jpg[/img]

[h2]FAQs[/h2]
・The game does not start - DirectX Issues
Please try booting from the local folder. If you get a message saying "d3dx9_30.dll is missing" please install DirectX user end runtime. https://microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=35

・ About key config, setting
Check our "Configuration" guide!

・ Switching Full Screen
Window size, full screen can be selected by key config application.
Also, if you press "enter" key during game, it will switch between Full screen and Window Mode

・ Screen is distorted at full screen
Please uncheck "Timer sync" in key config. However, in this case operation may be delayed depending on the environment.
